title: KISS receive loop imports ReceiveError only under TYPE_CHECKING
description: python/src/lichen/interface/kiss/bridge.py uses ReceiveError at runtime in _rx_loop, but imports it only beneath TYPE_CHECKING. Error paths raise NameError and two KISS loop tests fail. Import the exception at runtime, add/retain regression coverage, run focused tests and 3x module review.
close_reason: Fixed runtime ReceiveError import; 41 focused KISS tests pass. Correctness, security, and robustness reviews are dry; import-cycle smoke test passes.
